messages:
laura: Heads-up: customers seeing tiny billing blips when streams reconnect while background prefetch is active. Seen ~1-3 extra provisional tokens in traces.

mike: Yikes. Any repro traces?

laura: Pasted one (anonymized):
```
req=cl-11
route=us-east-1/prefetch
model=rdw-8k
user_tokens=28
prefetch_emitted=4
reconnects=1
ledger_provisional=31
ledger_confirmed=28
```

sophie: Reads like: prefetch emits chunk(s) -> we emit provisional credits -> stream reconnect confirms slightly different prefix -> provisional doesn't collapse. Could be toolcall/truncation interplay too.

raman: Two approaches: (A) runtime dedupe on resume (compare prefixes, drop provisional when overlap), or (B) ledger TTL auto-reconcile for entries tagged origin=prefetch. A has less ledger churn; B is safer with smaller blast radius.

mike: Prefix dedupe scares me because of off-by-one and truncation semantics when toolcall trimming occurs. We lost tokens before with naive prefix equality.

laura: Agreed. Proposal: add lightweight "origin" tag to provisional rows (values: user|prefetch|toolcall) + a nullable "link_id" to associate a provisional row with a later confirmation event. Then auto-convert prefetched provisional rows if a confirming event arrives within 750ms.

sophie: That avoids changing client API. Also suggest console change: token waterfall should show origin and collapse transient conversions (no toast) if conversion < TTL. Support sees fewer tickets then.

raman: Implementation notes: router needs to attach origin to resume/heartbeat events. Resume controller must emit confirmation with link_id that ledger can match. We'll default new fields to null so Dedicated/Private don't break.

mike: Ops considerations? write amplification? analytics accuracy?

raman: Ledger churn will spike while TTL window is retained. Compaction job must follow link_id to collapse rows after conversion. Analytics jobs that aggregate daily spend should treat provisional with origin=prefetch differently (we'll only count confirmed except when flagged). We'll add a migration to backfill origin=null->user for old rows.

sophie: Tests: unit tests simulating reconnect + prefetch, e2e in staging with TTL toggled. Also add a fuzz test for prefix off-by-one to ensure dedupe isn't needed.

ops-bot: ALERT: provisional-prefetch anomaly in us-east-1 at 2026-03-22T14:02Z count=134 threshold=100 :warning:

mike: OK that's live. Laura, file ticket with trace + proposed TTL flow. Raman, can you scope schema change and migration? Sophie, owner for runtime test harness.

laura: Filing ENG-4500 now, assigning sophie (runtime tests) + raman (ledger + migration) + mike (ship owner). Linking PRD-1010 for console UX.

raman: Will draft schema diff: add columns origin VARCHAR NULL, link_id VARCHAR NULL, default nulls. Add index on link_id to speed compaction.

laura: Product ask: hide transient conversions < TTL in waterfall, allow filter by origin, and add support FAQ blurb.

mike: Timeline: small staging canary in 48h, monitor provisional->confirmed ratio and ledger writes for 72h, then gradual prod rollout.

sophie: I'll add unit tests + a short simulation harness to ENG-4500.

laura: Thanks. Let's keep this tight; customers hate surprise micro-charges. :thumbsup:
